title: Certify and exhaust the prime61 horizontal class with a bounded-memory walker
status_note: Designed 2026-10-18, not frozen: the degree set's genus vectors (design-time, C1 to replay natively) give an unconditional lower bound of 545,296,208 vertices, covered by eight l=7 cycles of 68,162,026 run with the existing advance command (specs/coset-*.json). Envelope: ~234,936 core-hours (measurement 217,361), ~1.0 TB, <2 GB RAM; enumeration (716 core-hours) fits this host, measurement does not (~283 days on 32 vCPUs). Still needs code C1-C4, C6 (PROTOCOL.md section 8), an unconditional class number, and compute beyond one host or an owner decision.
blocked_on: note:code items C1 class-cover certificate, C2 unconditional h(D), C3 range-sharded measurement, C4 range verification, C6 union check; see PROTOCOL.md section 8
hw:about 217,361 core-hours of measurement; about 283 days on the 32-vCPU host, so a fleet or an owner decision is needed
question: What are the factor-base results over every base-field isomorphism class in the fixed ordinary prime61 trace class?
decision_value: Discharges the full-horizontal-class interpretation of the user's request. The degree-61 one-hop panel is complete within its bound but cannot establish a class-wide ranking. A verified resumable traversal would retain every cap and failure rather than infer the unseen results.

resources.notes: Derived in README.md from 2026-10-18 probes (probes/): N=545,296,208 vertices; enumeration 716 core-h (8 x 89.6, 4.73 ms/vertex), measurement 217,361 core-h (1.435 s/vertex), verification ~16,859 core-h (predicted, crude). Wall 7,342 h assumes 32 ideal workers; SMT and the shared host make it longer. Disk 562 GB for the eight cycle databases plus 1,117 GB raw run rows (~349 GB gzipped); RAM <2 GB (8 MiB SQLite cache, <20 MB per worker). run/shards below are Stage 2 (enumeration) only, which the existing CLI supports; Stage 3 needs C3.

outputs.result_schema: isogeny-disk-status/v1 per cycle (closed: discovered=68162026, edges=136324052, pending=0, failures=0) plus SQLite snapshot; class-wide table of PROTOCOL.md section 6 after Stage 3

env.name: crypto-native
env.recipe: Native Rust worker built with --no-default-features at the freezing commit; system libsqlite3.so.0; one process per coset database

funding.rationale: Blocked exhaustive-coverage follow-up priority only; does not schedule or fund a remote experiment.
